newSources.title: Jurien Bay — Coastal Camera
newSources.story: Open the official Jurien Bay coastal still for a westward view of blue water, a strip of beach and offshore land. A large framework and railing obstruct much of the foreground, so this is a limited coastal window rather than an unobstructed panorama. Check the capture clock; the image does not show sea-lion activity, establish safe swimming or navigation, or confirm a boat tour will run. Older archive frames are not today's conditions.
